attempts_counted_review_check.name: attempts_counted_review_check
attempts_counted_review_check.value: "attempts"."counted_for_review" is distinct from true or ("attempts"."review_mode" is not null and not "attempts"."skipped")

attempts_sentence_not_reviewable_check.name: attempts_sentence_not_reviewable_check
attempts_sentence_not_reviewable_check.value: "attempts"."mode" <> 'sentence' or ("attempts"."review_mode" is null and "attempts"."counted_for_review" is distinct from true)

attempts_review_mode_owner_check.name: attempts_review_mode_owner_check
attempts_review_mode_owner_check.value: "attempts"."review_mode" is null or ("attempts"."review_mode" = 'recognition' and "attempts"."mode" = 'memorize') or ("attempts"."review_mode" = 'spelling' and "attempts"."mode" = 'word')

attempts_review_stage_owner_check.name: attempts_review_stage_owner_check
attempts_review_stage_owner_check.value: "attempts"."review_mode" is null or ("attempts"."review_mode" = 'recognition' and "attempts"."mode" = 'memorize' and "attempts"."session_stage" in ('context', 'recall')) or ("attempts"."review_mode" = 'spelling' and "attempts"."mode" = 'word' and "attempts"."session_stage" = 'word_spelling')

attempts_review_session_check.name: attempts_review_session_check
attempts_review_session_check.value: "attempts"."review_mode" is null or "attempts"."review_session_id" is not null

attempts_session_stage_check.name: attempts_session_stage_check
attempts_session_stage_check.value: "attempts"."session_stage" is null or ("attempts"."mode" = 'word' and "attempts"."session_stage" = 'word_spelling') or ("attempts"."mode" = 'memorize' and "attempts"."session_stage" in ('context', 'recall', 'spell'))

lexicon_entries_content_shape_check.name: lexicon_entries_content_shape_check
lexicon_entries_content_shape_check.value: ("lexicon_entries"."content_type" = 'sense' and "lexicon_entries"."sense_role" is not null and "lexicon_entries"."usage_note_zh" is null) or ("lexicon_entries"."content_type" = 'usage_note' and "lexicon_entries"."sense_role" is null and "lexicon_entries"."translation" is null and "lexicon_entries"."part_of_speech" is null and "lexicon_entries"."phonetic" is null and "lexicon_entries"."definition_en" is null and "lexicon_entries"."sentence" is null and "lexicon_entries"."sentence_translation" is null and "lexicon_entries"."subject" is null and "lexicon_entries"."verb" is null and "lexicon_entries"."object" is null and "lexicon_entries"."usage_note_zh" is not null)

lexicon_sources_external_license_require.name: lexicon_sources_external_license_required
lexicon_sources_external_license_require.value: "lexicon_sources"."source_kind" = 'editorial' or ("lexicon_sources"."license_id" is not null and "lexicon_sources"."license_url" is not null)

word_books_owner_matches_source.name: word_books_owner_matches_source
word_books_owner_matches_source.value: ("word_books"."source" = 'official' and "word_books"."owner_user_id" is null) or ("word_books"."source" = 'custom' and "word_books"."owner_user_id" is not null)
